A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DSP work. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A.1–A.4 are available and readable, supporting a reliable comparison.

before.justification: Sections 5.1–5.3 and Figures 5–9 report original throughput, scaling, inference-latency, and memory measurements for 720M and 3B 2D-Transformers.

after.justification: v3 retains the original throughput, scaling, inference-latency, and memory experiments in Sections 5.1–5.3 and Figures 5–9.

M1.justification: DSP retains the same split, gather, and dynamic-switch operations, including all-to-all resharding between computation stages. Section 3 and the Appendix A.4 API show no change to the proposed procedure.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same OpenSora-like 2D-Transformer workloads, long sequences, training and inference performance, and intra-node/inter-node scaling scenarios. No evaluated dataset, domain, or task coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: The comparator set remains Megatron-SP, DeepSpeed-Ulysses, and Ring Attention. However, Sections 4.1/A.2 and Figure 10 revise the reported Ulysses implementation from communication in both transformer blocks to communication only in the temporal block. The PDFs do not establish that benchmarks were rerun.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix A.3 retain the hardware, model configurations, sequence lengths, parallelism settings, and weak/strong scaling procedures. Tables 4–7 contain the same experimental settings; no new evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: The scaling and memory analyses are retained without additional ablations, robustness tests, sensitivity studies, or case studies. Adding Ring Attention to Figure 10 illustrates an existing comparator rather than adding an experiment.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or experimental uncertainty estimates. The black boxes in the scaling plots denote ideal linear scaling in both versions.

E6.justification: Table 3 changes Ulysses's analytical communication result from 8M/N to 4M/N, while DSP remains 2M/N. The empirical plots in Figures 5–9 and their reported throughput, latency, scaling, and memory findings are unchanged.

T1.justification: Sections 4.1 and A.2 revise the communication-cost derivation to count four Ulysses communications per 2D layer instead of eight, yielding 4M/N. DSP's derivation, Equations 1–7, and the memory analysis remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract and contribution list narrow the communication advantage from roughly 75% or greater reduction to at least 50%. The DSP novelty and throughput claims remain unchanged. The introductory summary and conclusion still retain the older 75% claim.

C2.justification: The explanation of baseline overhead is refined: v3 confines Ulysses communication to the temporal block and removes Section 2.2's blanket attribution to head-dimension communication. Empirical interpretations and limitations concerning single-dimensional models and global operations are retained.

D1.justification: Appendix A.2 revises the documented Ulysses communication layout. The displayed code reference changes from OpenDiT to VideoSys, although the embedded hyperlink still targets OpenDiT. Hardware details, model settings, and the four-function API remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The bibliography retains the same works. Section 2.2 now explicitly characterizes FastFold as prior parallelism for multi-dimensional sequences, replacing the broader description of long-sequence and complex-operation parallelism. This modestly refines the positioning against prior work.

P1.justification: Most prose and section ordering are preserved. v3 adopts author-year citations, consolidates the related-work baseline paragraphs, and makes localized wording and caption edits without extensive narrative rewriting.

P2.justification: Figure 10 is redrawn to include the existing Ring Attention comparator and show temporal-only Ulysses communication. Other figures retain their content. Title, headers, and table styling change, and the unchanged API illustration moves to a separate final page.

improvement.justification: v3 improves analytical accuracy by correcting Ulysses's communication accounting and aligning the abstract, contribution list, and Figure 10 with a 50% reduction relative to Ulysses. The empirical evidence remains unchanged. The benefit is limited by incomplete propagation: the introduction and conclusion still claim 75%, Appendix A.2 still says Ring Attention is absent from the diagram, and the code label disagrees with its hyperlink.
